list.title: Personal WhatsApp numbers
list.subtitle: Link a WhatsApp number by QR code or pairing code. Chats on it appear in the shared inbox.
list.capFull: Your workspace can have {limit, plural, one {# number} other {# numbers}} on this engine. Delete one to connect another.
list.noMatch: No numbers match. Clear the search or pick another tab.

empty.title: No personal number is linked yet
empty.message: Link the WhatsApp number you already use. It works like WhatsApp Web, so it is not an approved way to automate WhatsApp and WhatsApp can restrict the number. For serious or long-term use, the official WhatsApp Business route is the lower-risk one.
empty.noPermission: Ask a workspace admin to connect a number.

noticeChanged.title: Our notice changed
noticeChanged.body: The risk notice for personal numbers was updated. Your connected numbers keep working. You will be asked to read it again the next time you connect one.

done.disconnectedNotUnlinked: {name} was disconnected here. Also remove this device in WhatsApp, under Linked devices.
done.deleted: {name} was deleted. Its chats stay in the inbox.

list.workerDown: The connection service is not running. Numbers cannot connect until it is back.

reason.unlinked_on_phone: WhatsApp ended the link to this number. This happens when the device is removed in WhatsApp, under Linked devices, and also when WhatsApp restricts a number. Your chats here are kept. You can link it again.
reason.forbidden: WhatsApp refused the connection. This can mean the number was restricted. Your chats here are kept.
reason.qr_timeout: The code was not scanned in time.
reason.pair_failed: WhatsApp could not finish linking this number.
reason.code_failed: The pairing code was not accepted.
reason.mismatch: The phone that scanned is not the number you entered. Check the number and try again.
reason.proxy_unreachable: The proxy did not answer. The number stays offline until it works.
reason.session_conflict: The same number is linked somewhere else and the two keep replacing each other. Remove the other link, then connect again.
reason.device_limit_reached: WhatsApp allows 4 linked devices. Remove one in WhatsApp, under Linked devices, and try again.
reason.worker_unavailable: The connection service is not available. Try again in a few minutes.
reason.worker_silent: The connection service stopped answering for this number. It reconnects by itself when the service is back.
reason.session_incomplete: The saved session was not finished. Link the number again.

notice.title: Before you connect
notice.intro: Read this. It is short and it is true.
notice.mustTick: Tick all three boxes to continue.
notice.pageIntro: This is the notice you accept before you connect a personal WhatsApp number.
notice.notAccepted: You have not accepted the current version yet. You are asked when you connect a number.

items.not_approved_ban_risk: I understand this connects my WhatsApp the way WhatsApp Web does. It is not an approved way to automate WhatsApp and it goes against WhatsApp's terms. WhatsApp can restrict or permanently ban this number at any time, including for normal use, and we cannot prevent it or get the number back.
items.own_number_expected_contacts: I will only connect a number I own or have the owner's permission to connect, and I can afford to lose it. I will only message people who expect to hear from me.
items.shared_inbox_disclosure: I understand that from the moment it is linked, every private chat on this number (not only business chats) appears in this workspace's shared inbox for members who can read the inbox, and messages I type on my phone are copied there too.

notes.official_route_lower_risk: The official WhatsApp Business route is the lower-risk one for serious or long-term use.
notes.warm_up: Warm up the number slowly and keep volumes low.
notes.no_ban_support: A restricted or banned number is not covered by support: we do not investigate it, restore it or refund it.
notes.shared_addresses: In this pilot, numbers connect from our servers' shared addresses (no proxy), so a restriction on one number can be linked to others.
notes.disconnect_keeps_chats: Disconnecting here removes the link and the saved session but does not delete the chats from the inbox.

number.title: Which number?
number.name: Name
number.nameHelp: Only your team sees this name.
number.phoneHelp: Type the number you will link, with its country. It must be the number of the phone that will scan or enter the code.

nameError.short: The name needs at least 2 characters.
nameError.long: The name is too long (191 characters at most).

phoneError.invalid: This number is not valid for the country chosen.

link.title: Link the phone
link.choose: How do you want to link it?
link.qrHelp: Scan with the phone that has this number.
link.codeHelp: Type an 8-character code on the phone. Good when you cannot scan.
link.needCountryCode: Add the country code to use a pairing code.
link.someoneElse: Only enter this code on the phone of the number you are connecting. Never share it with anyone else. A pairing code entered on someone else's phone links that person's whole WhatsApp account to this workspace.

qrSteps.three: Point the camera at this code.

codeSteps.two: Go to Linked devices, then Link a device, then Link with phone number instead.

link.qrAlt: QR code to link the number
link.codeValid: The code is valid for about 3 minutes.

result.timedOutTitle: The code was not scanned in time

result.phoneOfflineTitle: The phone could not be reached

result.loggedOutBody: This happens when the device is removed in WhatsApp, under Linked devices, and also when WhatsApp restricts a number. Your chats here are kept. You can link it again.

result.failedTitle: The number could not be linked

discard.title: Stop connecting?
discard.message: You have not finished. If you leave now, what you typed is lost and a link in progress is dropped.

detail.notFound: This number does not exist or was deleted.

detail.name: Name

disconnect.title: Disconnect {name}?
disconnect.message: This unlinks the number and removes its saved session. Conversations stay readable but can no longer be answered from this number until you link it again.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.message: This unlinks the number and removes its saved session. Conversations stay readable in the inbox but can no longer be answered from this number. This cannot be undone.
